description: Sets the founder's chosen domain on the formation. Pass an empty string to clear the selection. Domain registration only requires payment, NOT state approval: for a paid formation the domain is claimable immediately — tell the founder to finish registration now on the formation page or on the dashboard's Domains page (takes a minute), so their website is live while the state filing completes. For unpaid formations the domain is purchasable right after checkout.
name: formation_set_selected_domain
title: Set Selected Domain
